artworks.title: The Pensive Carpenter
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, hunched forward, resting his arm on a large rectangular wooden plank. He has facial features such as a pointed nose, a mustache, and deep-set eyes, with his hair mostly covered by a textured cap. The man wears a long-sleeved tunic and loose-fitting pants with visible folds. The setting includes a wooden bench and textured surfaces in the background, suggesting an interior space.

artworks.title: The Revenge of the Sorcerer Virgil
artworks.description: The image shows two figures - one seated and one standing beside them. The seated person is positioned on an architectural platform, facing left with one knee bent and the other leg slanted downward. They have delicate features, long flowing hair/headwear, and hold a staff. The standing figure looks up towards the seated person with curly hair. The setting includes a patterned pedestal, textures, and an object resembling a lantern in the foreground. The artwork is richly detailed, likely engraved or etched.

artworks.title: Knight in Armour with Bread and Wine
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing in profile wearing full armor, including a helmet with a closed visor. Atop the helmet is a plumed crest. The armor is detailed and covers the torso, arms, and legs. The person stands with one arm raised, holding a long cloth that extends to a vase-like object atop a pedestal, and the other arm outstretched, either resting on or holding another draped cloth. The background features a tree trunk with hanging drapery.

artworks.title: Bathing Woman
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a flat surface. They are mostly nude, with part of their upper and lower body visible. The person is in a seated position, leaning slightly forward with their left arm resting on their left knee. Their head is turned downwards, partially obscuring their facial features. They have long hair cascading over their shoulders and are wearing a distinctive cap. The person's form is muscular, with textured skin. There are no visible articles of clothing apart from the cap, and they are not holding any objects. In the background, architectural elements such as a column and a ledge or wall suggest a structured environment with textured stone or brickwork.

artworks.title: Covered Goblet with Young Hercules
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate vessel with intricate details. The image depicts a cup or urn with a lid, featuring decorations and motifs characteristic of the Renaissance period. The lid showcases a small statue figure holding a ribbon. The vessel is adorned with swirling patterns and textures, demonstrating craftsmanship and attention to detail. The overall mood conveys opulence and artistic skill, encapsulating a sense of historical and aesthetic richness.

artworks.title: Covered Goblet with Winged Ball
artworks.description: The image shows a large urn with intricate designs on its body and base. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray. The urn is positioned centrally in the frame with the lid at the top and a wide base at the bottom, creating a symmetrical composition.

artworks.title: Covered Goblet with Grapes on the Stem
artworks.description: The image shows a large urn with a lid, featuring intricate carvings and ornamentation. The color palette consists of shades of brown and beige. The urn is in the center of the image, with a finial at the top. The background is dark with a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Young Man and Maids
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. Two are seated, while one is standing. The seated figure on the left has a side profile with their head turned slightly to the right. They wear a headpiece with hanging ribbons, a beaded necklace, and a detailed dress. Their legs are visible. The seated person in the center faces forward, wearing a similar headpiece and holding an object. The standing person has their back to the viewer and is leaning towards the seated figures. They have their hair tied back and wear a flowing garment. The background includes a brick wall with a window casting light into the scene.

artworks.title: Albrecht Altdorfer
artworks.description: The image presents a bust-length portrait of a man within an ornate oval frame. The man is facing forward, showing his elongated face with a prominent forehead and long beard. He wears a cap and a garment with a high collar. The portrait is surrounded by a decorative border with floral patterns and scrolls. A ribbon above the figure bears the name "ALBERT ALTDORFER" in capital letters. In the background, there are stylized engravings of tree branches and foliage.

artworks.title: Arion and a Nereid
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures with marine creatures. The image depicts two figures often seen in mythology, appearing to be a merman and mermaid, interacting with large sea creatures which resemble fantastical fish. The merman is shown with a muscular build, holding a trident-like object, while the mermaid is reaching out with a vine or ribbon-like object. The water around them is suggested by a series of swirling lines. In the background, there is a small landmass. The figures and creatures are rendered in a detailed, textural manner, consistent with traditional engravings or woodcuts.

artworks.title: Gaspar de Coligny
artworks.description: The image depicts an intricate engraving of a mature man in elaborate armor, facing slightly right with a baton in his left hand. He has distinct facial features, including a pronounced nose, strong jaw, and beard. The frame around him includes mythological figures and floral motifs, with classical women on each side. The background shows allegorical imagery, clouds, and a distant landscape view. Below, a town square scene with small figures in motion is surrounded by decorative elements.

artworks.title: The Hierarchy of the Heavens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene filled with intricate figures arranged hierarchically. The image is detailed and composed of multiple layers with various groups of figures. There are ornamental borders with arabesques and floral patterns. Each layer features figures in different actions, creating a sense of movement and narrative. The upper part of the drawing is more elaborate, with converging lines indicating perspective and hierarchy. The details and arrangement suggest a story or progression, evoking grandeur and symmetry.

artworks.title: Christ before Pilate
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.1 x 31.4 cm (11 7/16 x 12 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man in the center with his hands bound, surrounded by several other figures in armor and helmets holding weapons. One figure labeled "PILATUS" points towards the central figure while seated on a chair. The background has diagonal lines to imply depth, and the ground includes a pedestal with engravings.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.artist: Giovanni Antonio da Brescia, after Andrea Mantegna
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people engaged in a scene of mourning or religious significance. The scene is detailed with a backdrop of hills and crosses. The artwork includes figures displaying various emotions, with some figures supporting or carrying the lifeless body of a central figure wrapped in a shroud. The landscape features rocky outcrops and distant clouds. The inscription "HVMANI GENERIS REDEMpTORI" is prominently placed in the foreground beside the central figure. The artwork is richly textured, with careful attention to the folds of the clothing and the expressions of the figures, likely created in a traditional style reminiscent of Renaissance engravings.

artworks.title: Page from Livius Historiabum Libri
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an illustrated page from a historical text. The drawing features a woodcut-like image at the top depicting a Roman religious or ritual scene, with a procession of figures holding a bier or platform displaying a reclining figure, with the backdrop of a city wall labeled "Roma". Below the image, there is Latin text, possibly from historical accounts or literature, ornamented by a small decorative illustration of two dancing figures or cherubs in a framed box. The page layout suggests it is taken from an old book with detailed captions and annotations in the margins, likely from historical or literary works of ancient Rome.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel with Dragons, Masks, and Instruments of War
artworks.description: This is an image of an ornamental design with mythical creatures. The design features intricate patterns and fantastical elements, including winged dragons, floral motifs, scrolls, and faces with a mythical or grotesque appearance. It has a symmetrical composition with a column-like structure in the center adorned with foliage and griffon-like creatures. The drawing is done in fine lines, resembling an etching or engraving.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel: Triton Ridden by a Child
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate vertical ornamental design. The drawing consists of ornate and classical motifs arranged in a symmetrical pattern. At the top of the image, there is a decorative heraldic shield surrounded by scrollwork and leaf-like patterns. Below the shield, a cherub-like figure with wings is depicted, holding what seem to be staffs or spears. Further down, the design incorporates a central urn or vase adorned with floral elements and flanked by intricate foliage. Additionally, there are two human figures at the bottom, one holding a large snake, the other holding a spear, set against a background of acanthus leaves and classical design elements. The entire composition is black and white.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel: Two Children Wearing Helmets
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental design with classical architecture, scrollwork, floral patterns, a torso without arms or legs, decorative symbols like vases, foliage, shields, helmets, mythological figures, vines, and scrolls. The composition is symmetrical and balanced.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel: Four Children Playing
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
artworks.description: The image shows a vertical series of intricate, symmetrical arrangements with swirling lines, floral motifs, and geometric patterns. The abstract composition resembles a totem-like structure, with elements that could be interpreted as resembling a vase, tree, or architectural column. Recognizable forms like two cherubic figures appear within the design, suggesting ornamental and classical influences. These elements combine to create a rich, ornamental quality that is complex and detailed, reminiscent of historical sculptural reliefs or decorative arts.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel: Satyr Holding a Violin
artworks.artist: Giovanni Pietro Birago and Zoan Andrea
artworks.description: This is a drawing of elaborate ornamental designs and figures. The artwork features a vertical composition of intricate, decorative elements including vases, floral motifs, and scrollwork interspersed with classical sculptures. At the top, there is an urn surrounded by stylized foliage and ornamental patterning. Below that, a muscular torso of a statue appears as a central focal point, alongside a variety of swirling designs. In the middle of the drawing, two small nude figures are depicted standing together, embraced within arboreal shapes. Further down, a seated, bearded figure holds various attributes, including what appears to be a pen or quill, alongside an hourglass.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, tan, and ochre
artworks.description: The image shows two people and an infant. One person is seated while the other is standing and holding an axe as if to chop wood. The seated person has long hair and wears a red garment with line detailing. The standing person has short hair and wears a tan tunic. An infant is swaddled and placed in a crib between them. The background is teal with scattered lines indicating wood. The image is framed with a decorative border on aged paper.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, yellow, tan, olive, and pink

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, brown, slate blue, ochre, and blue
artworks.description: This is a painting of a nativity scene. Two figures in robes kneel in front of a stable with a central resting figure, surrounded by animals, and architecture in the background.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: The image displays multiple figures in a scene. One woman with long, wavy hair is seated, holding a baby. Both have halos over their heads. The woman wears a long robe while the baby is also adorned and has a halo. Beside them, a man with a beard wears a hat and holds a container while kneeling. Another kneeling man with a beard wears a crown and holds a chalice. A standing man with a crown and robe gestures. An animal, possibly a dog, is near the men. The background features a thatched-roof structure with a man inside, stylized trees, hills, towers, and other distant structures. The scene is detailed with various textures and patterns.
